name: personal-skills
description: A repo-agnostic workflow-and-design library for Claude Code, built around one front door. /orchestrate ensures a corpus/ workspace exists, reads corpus/routing.md, classifies the request and routes it — capture to corpus-flow (an LLM-maintained project wiki, glossary and decisions log plus a todos-to-briefs-to-done lifecycle), build to plan-split-dispatch (model-routed subagent implementation with a mandatory review gate, a bounded escalating fix loop and a ruling ledger that survives compaction), "what should we work on" to improve (a read-only senior-advisor survey that audits with parallel per-lens finders, vets every finding against the source and the corpus's locked decisions, ranks by leverage and writes the promoted ones up as briefs), and questions to the wiki. Research and audit are gated: they surface options and stop for your pick, never an auto-build. grill-me interviews you in dependency-ordered rounds, finds facts itself instead of asking, and records the durable outcomes as glossary terms and decisions. On the design side it ships impeccable (the Apache-2.0 build engine, 23 sub-commands), the taste suite (design-taste-frontend plus the minimalist, industrial-brutalist and high-end presets and redesign-existing-projects), design-md-library (74 real-brand DESIGN.md references), diagram-design (39 editorial diagram types as self-contained HTML+SVG), and web-design-guidelines / writing-guidelines wrappers that fetch Vercel's rules fresh at review time. Plus unslop (cut AI tells from prose), thermo-nuclear-review (an extremely strict maintainability pass), codegraph (graph-first, grep-verified code understanding), corpus-docs-site (a Starlight docs site generated from the corpus and the TypeScript), ui-test-plans and bootstrap-vps-deploy. The Vercel suite adds UI and prose guideline reviews (rules fetched fresh each run), React best-practices, view transitions, and composition patterns. corpus-flow's domain-modeling layer (§9) keeps the project's vocabulary honest: an opinionated glossary where each term lists the synonyms it displaces, a decisions format with the categories that qualify, a glossary map for multi-context monorepos, and the active discipline of challenging conflicting terms and cross-referencing them against the code. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
